weaknesses.summary: 12/12 agents flagged this — hidden guardrail risk.

refinement_suggestions: Narrow the Smart Resume hero to activate only for users who have opened the app and resumed the same title at least 3 times in the past 7 days (high-frequency active viewers), explicitly excluding users with no activity in the past 14 days — this directly addresses the wrong-cohort problem where infrequent or churning users see a degraded discovery surface they don't benefit from.

Add a persistent, always-visible 'Switch title' affordance (e.g., a left/right chevron or a thumbnail strip of 2-3 other in-progress titles) directly on the Smart Resume hero card rather than hiding alternatives behind a 'More options' expander — this fixes the broken mechanism where users with multiple active titles or shared household accounts lose access to their second choice without an extra tap that most will never discover.

Gate the Smart Resume hero behind an A/B test that measures not just resume-tap rate but also downstream session depth (minutes watched per session) and 7-day retention, with a pre-registered guardrail that rolls back if editorial hero impressions for cold-start users drop more than 5% due to misclassification — this surfaces the hidden guardrail risk that the cold-start fallback logic may misfire for lapsed or multi-profile users.

result.metric_lift_relative: Treatment converts directionally lower than control on 12 paired identities; the paired-bootstrap interval straddles zero (not separable). Synthetic conversion is a weak behavioral signal — read as rank/direction, not as a calibrated effect size. NOTE: the treatment metric ran UNBLINDED (the change had no faithful standalone view), so this direction is low-confidence and may overstate the treatment arm. NOTE: one or more personas in this run lack per-persona behavioral seeds (a v1.0-class pack), so cross-persona variance is degraded — a flat or non-separable metric here may reflect collapsed agent variance rather than a true null effect. Rebuild the pack to v1.1 to de-attenuate. NOTE: only 12 paired identities — below the ~30 needed for the paired bootstrap to separate a moderate effect, so this non-separable result is INCONCLUSIVE (the panel cannot detect an effect of plausible size), NOT evidence of no effect. Increase agents per arm to power the comparison.
